title: malache schrankii
intro: Malache schrankii, commonly known as Malachra schrankii, is a plant species belonging to the family Malvaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Malache schrankii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the plant's therapeutic potential and its effects on human health.
